steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
src_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/ep2-b11-plate-pub-0817-out"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b11-plate-pub-0817"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob(src_dir + "/11-they-leave-mac-plate-r3s1.*"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b11-plate-pub-0817.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) >= 2 else 1)
